hedging_summary.stated_hedging_policy: No commodity hedging. The 5 derivative mentions relate to embedded conversion option liabilities on convertible promissory notes and warrants issued to noteholders, not commodity hedging instruments.

metadata.notes: Fiscal year ended April 30, 2014. Production and per-BOE metrics from item7 table. Reserves in Bbls (oil) and Mcf (gas) - proved oil reserves = 64,187 Bbls, proved gas reserves = 33,136 Mcf, total proved BOE not explicitly stated but computable as 64,187 + 33,136/6 = 69,710 BOE. Proved developed = 29,507 oil Bbls, 31,781 gas Mcf. Proved undeveloped = 34,680 oil Bbls, 1,355 gas Mcf. NGL reserves are embedded in gas Mcf column (multiplied by 6 to convert from Bbls to Mcf equivalent). Revenue: oil $887,087, gas+NGL $71,255 (includes NGL revenue of $56,737), total $958,342. LOE $116,347. Average prices realized: oil $92.76/Bbl, gas $5.45/Mcf, total $81.62/BOE. Production 81% oil, 19% gas+NGL. LOE includes ad valorem taxes. Derivative mentions relate to convertible note embedded conversion option liabilities and warrants to noteholders, not commodity hedges.
